description: This source file defines a GUI component for visualizing network topology using Fyne library, including a 'Concentric' layout for arranging objects and a periodic timer function to update the topology display.

classes.name: Concentric
classes.description: A layout object that arranges canvas objects in concentric circles, updating positions based on angles and radius, for visualization purposes.

methods.name: MinSize
methods.description: Returns a fixed minimum size for the Concentric layout, set to 50x50.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Calculates and assigns positions to canvas objects in concentric circles, rotating objects based on angles and increasing radius periodically.

methods.name: periodicTimer
methods.description: Adds an image and a text label to the topology canvas, intended to update the topology visualization periodically.
